info.name: MY GARB Backend - Milestones 1 to 6 + Email Verification
info.description:
M1/M2 actual API requests. Run once in order with a fresh cookie jar and fresh rate-limit budget. Recommended: npm run test:postman (local test database, random in-memory password, owned fixture cleanup). GUI runs generate fictional emails and an ephemeral password unless authPassword is privately supplied. GUI accounts remain in the selected server database. Final request intentionally exhausts the default auth limit; wait 15 minutes before another GUI run. Never export populated environments, cookies, or raw run reports. No public admin endpoint exists. See docs/postman/README.md.

Email Verification folder: additional API 0.7.0 manual OTP/Postman tests. Read its folder description before running. Run its read-only contract check first; all write requests are guarded until that check confirms the OTP-capable contract. Rate-limit scenarios must be run separately against a fresh isolated API process. Email Verification write requests are guarded by an explicit isolated-database confirmation collection variable as well as an API 0.7.0 contract check.

request.description: Login customer. Expected HTTP 200. Run in folder order using the cookie jar. No bearer token is used.

exec: pm.test('Exact safe user structure and identity', () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.all.keys('success','data'); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.data).to.have.all.keys('user'); const u=b.data.user; pm.expect(u).to.have.all.keys('id','name','email','role','status'); pm.expect(u.id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{24}$/); pm.expect(u.name).to.eql('Demo customer'); pm.expect(u.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('customerEmail')); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('customer'); pm.expect(u.status).to.eql('active'); pm.environment.set('customerId',u.id); });

pm.test('Session cookie attributes', () => { const h=pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(/^mygarb_session=[^;]+;/.test(h)).to.eql(true); for (const a of ['HttpOnly','SameSite=Strict','Path=/api']) pm.expect(h.includes(a)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(/;\s*Domain=/i.test(h)).to.eql(false); });

item.name: Email Verification
item.description: API 0.7.0 manual-mailbox scenarios. Before any write, verify the selected API uses only local mygarb_phasonable_test, then set collection variable emailVerificationIsolatedTestDatabase to confirmed. Real email delivery to inboxes you control is also required; this collection does not capture or fake OTPs. First run the read-only contract check. Every write request is skipped until both the API 0.7.0 check passes and the isolated-database variable is explicitly confirmed. Registration/resend return the same generic 202 for eligible, ineligible, cooldown, and delivery outcomes. OTPs expire in 10 minutes, allow 5 attempts, have a 60-second resend cooldown and up to five sends per account in a 24-hour window measured from the first send. Registration and resend share 5 requests/hour/IP; verification allows 15 requests/15 minutes/IP. Do not run every account scenario in one uninterrupted sequence: registration, duplicate-registration, and resend calls share the hourly IP budget. Run the customer, designer, duplicate, and expiry scenarios in separate windows as needed. Rate-limit request groups are opt-in and should be selected/run alone with a fresh isolated API process/window. See docs/postman/README.md for manual OTP and safety steps.
